view.name: Commercial ANZ Landscape
view.documentation: Application cooperation view for the ANZ commercial domain. Commercial ANZ is the central collaboration boundary. The internal estate is grouped into Customer Service, Sales, SPT, Marketing, and Finance. Microsoft Dynamics spans Customer Service, Sales, and SPT. Informatica PIM ANZ is shown on the left as an upstream integration into Magento ANZ, while QAD EE 2019 is shown on the right as a downstream ERP integration from Microsoft Dynamics.

view.name: CRM Consolidation Case
view.documentation: MVP9 test - shows CRM landscape with emphasis treatments

view.name: Data and Analytics Landscape
view.documentation: Application cooperation view for the Data and Analytics domain. The central collaboration contains the major platform and service components grouped into Data Ingestion, Data Warehousing, Analytics, Automation, and DevOps. Source applications integrate inbound from the left, while Medlink is shown as a downstream consumer on the right.

view.name: ERP ANZ Landscape
view.documentation: Application cooperation view for the ANZ ERP realm. ERP ANZ is the central collaboration/core. QAD EE 2019 and Pro2SQL ANZ are contained within that core. External systems sit around the core and connect only through explicit outbound flows.

view.name: ERP JPN Landscape
view.documentation: Application cooperation view for the JPN ERP realm. ERP JPN is the central collaboration/core. QAD SE 11 and Pro2SQL JPN are contained within that core. External systems sit around the core and connect only through explicit outbound flows.

view.name: QAD Migration Options
view.documentation: Comparison view showing two stacked migration options from the three current QAD instances into alternative target cores, then through an analytical database and Boomi to shared downstream services.

view.name: Infrastructure Cost Optimization Roadmap
view.documentation: Infrastructure transformation roadmap focused on reducing Azure and DC overspend through serverless adoption, regional consolidation, and unified support services

view.name: Operations ANZ Landscape
view.documentation: Application cooperation view for the ANZ operations domain. Operations - ANZ is the central collaboration boundary. The internal estate is grouped into Production/QA, Warehouse, Planning, and QARA. QAD EE 2019 and Pro2SQL ANZ are shown on the left as upstream systems with direct inbound integrations.

view.name: Operations JPN Landscape
view.documentation: Application cooperation view for the JPN operations domain. Operations - JPN is the central collaboration boundary. The internal estate is grouped into Production/QA, Warehouse, Planning, and QARA. QAD SE 11, Pro2SQL JPN, Yusen, and VC Vendor Collaboration are shown on the left as upstream systems with direct inbound integrations.

view.name: PSS 2.0 Azure Reference Architecture
view.documentation: Azure-native target architecture for PSS 2.0. This diagram is intended as the first reusable modernization template for application upgrades in an Azure-first environment. It contrasts the legacy server-hosted pattern with the target Azure runtime pattern and makes the supporting platform services explicit.
